## Station clustering

GTFS ships **36 383 stops**, all with `location_type=0` and an empty `parent_station` — there is no station hierarchy in the feed, so the grouping below is ours. **35 445** of those stops are served by a mode we keep.

| mode | stops before | points after | absorbed | rule |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `metro` | 44 | 44 | 0 | same name + same mode within 150 m |
| `s-train` | 88 | 88 | 0 | same name + same mode within 150 m |
| `rail` | 459 | 458 | 1 | same name + same mode within 150 m |
| `light-rail` | 173 | 109 | 64 | same name + same mode within 150 m |
| `bus` | 34 845 | 24 501 | 10 344 | same name + same mode within 50 m |
| **total** | **35 609** | **25 200** | **10 409** | |

A stop serving several modes is counted once per mode — **160 stops serve more than one**, which is why the 'before' column sums to more than the number of distinct stops.

**Heavy rail barely clusters, and that is the feed telling us something.** Metro, S-train and rail are already one row per station in Rejseplanen's data, not one row per platform. The merging that does happen is light rail (paired directional stops) and buses (both sides of a street).

## Dropped points

**212** points fell outside every Danish municipality polygon and were dropped.

| category/sub | dropped |
|---|---:|
| `transport/bus` | 89 |
| `transport/rail` | 73 |
| `food/restaurant` | 23 |
| `food/cafe` | 15 |
| `food/fast_food` | 7 |
| `food/bar` | 5 |

Mostly Rejseplanen's Swedish stops (Skånetrafiken crosses the Øresund) plus a few OSM points on harbour structures and ferries that lie outside the land polygons.

## Reconciliation against the probe

[`SERVICES_PROBE.md`](SERVICES_PROBE.md) counted the same OSM tags straight off the extract, with no deduplication and no kommune clipping. Every difference is accounted for:

| | probe | here | difference |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| grocery | 3 957 | 3 957 | — |
| food | 14 718 | 14 641 | −27 dual-tagged, −50 outside Denmark |
| pharmacy | 545 | 545 | — |

**27 objects carry two of our tags at once** — a petrol-station shop that is also a takeaway counter, a bakery that is also a café. `--distinct OSM ids only` means each is one point, and the category order grocery → pharmacy → food decides which: they are counted as groceries, so the grocery totals match the probe exactly and the food total is that much lower.
